Can we have a way to increase the depth at which comment trees are cut off? It would make reading comments much easier, and you would be able to see right away where the conversation is.

Right now the comment tree is cut off at depth 3. That means if I reply to someone who's replied to another comment, no replies to my comment will be shown on the main page, and anyone else who wants to read those can't just expand the tree, but has follow a link and go to another page. This makes it hard to see the entire conversation at once.

Crucially, since most of us can't downvote yet, the only way we know some troll's link in the comments is NSFW is if other people have commented on it, and usually these comments are too deep in the tree to be visible. I'm at work right now and I just clicked on someone's link that was not marked as NSFW thinking it would be cute bunnies or something, but turned out to be porn. The comment had 9 upvotes. One would expect these trolling comments to be voted down to hell, but some people probably find them funny, so they get more upvotes than neutral comments, and all the comments that warn of NSFW content are cut off.

TL;DR: Would be nice if we could see more of the comments all at once.
